Rank 2 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 15 ki
Casting Time: When you take the attack action or
roll a Combo Attack Roll
Range: Self
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Push your strikes even FURTHER using Ki. For the
duration of this technique you gain +1 Static Bonus to
all Melee Attacks and Melee Techniques.
